newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Uralsvyazinform to apply for ADR issue.
newsitem.headline: Russian Uralsvyazinform to apply for ADR issue.

text.p: Russia's AO Uralsvyazinform telecoms company plans to file the necessary documents in early November to issue Level One American Depositary Receipts, a company official said on Friday.

"There are no delays (in preparation) on our part," Svyazinform property and securities department head Anatoly Vaneyev told Reuters. "We shall submit the documents to the (U.S.) Securities and Exchange Commission at the start of November -- that's for sure."
Clifford Chance is the investment consultant for the project. Uralsvyazinform decided to choose Bank of New York as the depositary, but had not signed a contract yet, Vaneyev said.
Uralsvyazinform accounts for 98 percent of long distance calls and 80 percent of local calls market in Perm region in the Urals.
Its 1995 net profit amounted to 91.93 billion roubles.
The company's auditor is Coopers & Lybrand.
Uralsvyazinform's authorised capital equals 912.10 billion roubles (about $168 million).
In May a shareholders' meeting approved a possibility to increase the capital by $8 million through a new share issue.
But the issue never took place.
AO Svyazinvest holds a controlling stake in Uralsvyazinform, while the company's management has 12 percent of shares and employees have 30 percent, foreign investors have four percent.
